# Comparison Table

`comparison/comparison-table` &middot; section-level &middot; category: comparison

## Purpose

A comparison table: column headers, rows of label and values, and an optional button row. yes, no and partial become check, cross and tilde.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | list of object { title, subtitle, image, highlight } (2 to 4) |  |
| `rows` | list of object { label, values } (1 to 20) |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `intro` | text |  |
| `footer` | list of cta { label, href } (2 to 4) |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Clean rows with hairline dividers.
- **zebra**: Alternating row shading. Sets `zebra: true`.
- **tinted**: On the page background color, with white highlight cells. Sets `background: @colors.background`, `highlightBackground: @colors.surface`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `labelWidth` | text | `"34%"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `headerBackground` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `headerColor` | color | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `highlightHeader` | color | `"@colors.accent"` |
| `highlightBackground` | color | `"@colors.background"` |
| `zebra` | boolean | `false` |
| `zebraColor` | color | `"@colors.background"` |
| `borderColor` | color | `"@colors.border"` |
| `yesColor` | color | `"@colors.success"` |
| `noColor` | color | `"@colors.mutedText"` |
| `buttonBackground` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `buttonColor` | color | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `radius` | length | `"@theme.button.radius"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tables, colors and borders honored. | Fine. On phones the columns shrink, so keep cell text short. | Cells on the surface or background swap via dm-* classes. Header cells keep their colors. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('comparison/comparison-table', {
  "heading": "How we compare",
  "columns": [
    {
      "title": "Us",
      "highlight": true
    },
    {
      "title": "Fast fashion"
    },
    {
      "title": "Luxury brands"
    }
  ],
  "rows": [
    {
      "label": "Natural fabrics",
      "values": [
        "yes",
        "no",
        "yes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Free repairs",
      "values": [
        "yes",
        "no",
        "partial"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Typical price of a shirt",
      "values": [
        "$120",
        "$25",
        "$400"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Made to last a decade",
      "values": [
        "yes",
        "no",
        "yes"
      ]
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```
